official_name: Interaction of Replacement and/or Prevention Effects

zones: all zones touched by a replaceable event
state_writes: an immutable transformed event tree, entry reservation scope, and exact applied-effect journal
choices: affected player or object controller chooses among the current priority class
hidden_information: choice packets expose visible option labels and IDs but never authoritative batch IDs, event paths, payloads, or prior journals
apnap: simultaneous choices for different affected players are traversed in APNAP order
layers: as-enters copy/control effects interact with continuous-effect layer 1 or 2 after the event
copy: enters-copy replacements have priority before other replacements
control_change: enters-control replacements have priority before enters-copy replacements
zone_change: destination replacements transform the same zone-change event
source_leaves: applicability is rechecked after every chosen replacement

implementation.component: replacement_effects event trees and batches plus replacement_decisions suspension and the counter_placement transaction owner

known_blockers: generic replacement choice packets are wired only into represented token-creation, semantic zone-change, and effect-generated permanent-counter producers
multiple simultaneous events for the same affected chooser do not expose an explicit event-order choice when order could matter
entry reservation scopes are not yet consumed by general as-enters choice transactions
draw, damage, remaining counter-placement producers, commander movement, and other replacement producers remain outside the universal event boundary
